title: 7 Billion Needles
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Withdrawn high schooler Hikaru Takabe, grieving her family, is killed and rebuilt by an alien intelligence that now shares her body and is hunting a malicious alien hiding among her classmates. Loosely based on Hal Clement's novel Needle, the four-volume series mixes body horror and alien-invasion action with a coming-of-age story about connection.
life_message: Opening up to other people, despite grief and fear, is what lets a person and a community survive.
